cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：使烦扰
cards.example_en: Long speeches bore the students waiting in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 冗长的发言让在礼堂里等候的学生感到厌烦。

cards.example_en: A fence marks the boundary of the school field.
cards.example_zh: 一道篱笆标出了学校操场的边界。

cards.example_en: A soft breeze moved the curtains in the afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 午后，一阵和风吹动了窗帘。

cards.example_en: We may cancel the picnic if it rains.
cards.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们可能取消野餐。

cards.example_en: Our cat sleeps on the sofa every afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 我们的猫每天下午都在沙发上睡觉。

cards.example_en: The chairman opened the meeting with a short speech.
cards.example_zh: 主席用一段简短的讲话开始了会议。

cards.example_en: The chicken in the yard laid an egg this morning.
cards.example_zh: 院子里的鸡今天早上生了一枚蛋。

cards.example_en: We laughed all through the comedy that the drama club put on.
cards.example_zh: 戏剧社演的那出喜剧，我们从头笑到尾。

cards.example_en: We consult the coach before changing the match plan.
cards.example_zh: 更改比赛方案之前，我们会先和教练商量。

cards.example_en: The photography course uses the darkroom behind the art studio.
cards.example_zh: 摄影课程使用美术教室后面的暗房。

cards.example_en: The neighbour's cow pushed her head over the fence towards our apples.
cards.example_zh: 邻居家的奶牛把头伸过篱笆，凑向我们的苹果。

cards.example_en: She will dedicate this song to her mother.
cards.example_zh: 她要把这首歌献给妈妈。

cards.example_en: Our dog sleeps under the table whenever we eat dumplings.
cards.example_zh: 我们一吃饺子，狗就睡到桌子底下。

cards.example_en: A duck led five ducklings across the path beside the boating lake.
cards.example_zh: 一只鸭子领着五只小鸭穿过划船湖边的小路。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：荷兰的
cards.example_en: We tried Dutch cheese at the food stall beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们在河边的食品摊品尝了荷兰奶酪。
